Hi Samir —

Great talking earlier. Per our conversation, I’m sending a short proposal to extend your trial window by two weeks and provide a one-time closing stipend to help you complete the PoC ingestion and a production-like load test before your procurement cutoff.

High-level:
- 14-day trial extension (same model access, isolated project).
- One-time stipend: $7,500 account credit applied to billable usage within 30 days.
- Conditional on signature of the attached short SOW and acceptance of the standard trial terms.

I’ve attached a brief proposal and a credit schedule for transparency. If this looks good I can route for approval today and send an execution link.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call tomorrow to confirm scope + DocuSign link by EOD.

Thanks,

Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few questions before we proceed:
1) Is the $7.5k credit a prepay or applied after usage? Any expiration?
2) Are there data residency or audit logs changes during the extended trial? We need to preserve SOC2 evidence for our security review.
3) Can we get an itemized schedule of what the stipend is intended to cover (tokens, storage, support hours)?

Procurement is moving quickly but they need a one-page summary for internal sign-off. If you can confirm the answers we can get legal/procurement to review the SOW tomorrow.

Forwarding Samir’s questions. I recommend we approve a $7.5k applied credit (post-usage rebate applied within billing window, expires 30 days after issuance) plus a short one-pager on scope and security notes.

Rationale: Ava Health is high-velocity (fast POC, strong upsell signal into Dedicated in H1), procurement is locked until EOW — approving accelerates sign and reduces churn risk.

Suggested bullet answers for Ben to send to Samir:
- Credit mechanics: credit applied to invoice as a post-usage balance; non-refundable; must be used within 30 days of issuance.
- Residency/audit: No change to data residency; trial extension remains covered under existing SOC2 controls. We’ll attach the SOC2 evidence packet (redacted).
- Itemization: credit covers billable token consumption and storage; includes 2 hours of priority onboarding support (AM/SE hours).

If you both agree I’ll sign off and Marissa can add the accounting code for tracking.

— Mina

Thanks — answers below and attached one-pager. Quoted from your note: 

> Is the $7.5k credit a prepay or applied after usage? Any expiration?

We’ll apply the $7,500 as an invoice credit (post-usage) that reduces your next invoice. The credit expires 30 days after issuance; any unused remainder is forfeited.

> Are there data residency or audit logs changes during the extended trial?

No changes. The extended trial remains under your existing contract and SOC2 coverage. We are attaching the SOC2 evidence packet for procurement review.

> Can we get an itemized schedule of what the stipend is intended to cover (tokens, storage, support hours)?

See attached credit schedule: covers billable token consumption and storage during the 14-day extension and includes 2 hours of priority onboarding support with an SE.

If that works I’ll send the DocuSign link to execute the one-page SOW. Goal: get signature today so we can apply the credit and extend access tomorrow morning.
